_arch_note: DEPTH-SPLIT heterogeneous FFN (task 82850dee). Per-layer ffn_type: layers 0,1,2 = LUT FFN; layers 3,4,5 = standard dense GELU FFN. NOT a within-layer hybrid -- each layer is purely one type, via the guarded cfg['ffn_type_per_layer'] knob (default absent => uniform, byte-identical). LUT layers (0-2): plain 0207 geometry -- LightMultiHeadLUT, lut_impl light, cell_mode constant, confidence_form margin, H=8, tph=64, nap=8 (256 cells), read_top_n=1, inner_in=inner_out=48, full-rank compress. Dense layers (3-5): standard 2-layer GELU MLP with 4x widening (inner_d=1536, dense_inner_dim NOT set so it defaults to 4*d_model). MOTIVATION: the hybrid gate/stack diagnostics both showed early layers prefer LUT, late layers prefer dense -- this hard-wires that split to see how a heterogeneous model performs vs uniform LUT / uniform dense at 16k. Same fully-annealed 16k schedule as exp_n_0135/0176/0219: n_steps=16000, warmup 1600, cosine to 0.1x floor, peak LR 3e-4, wd 0.1, d_model=384 6L 6h seq512, untied, seed 1, corrected fixed eval bs48x100 skip12. device_batch 12 x grad_accum 4 = 24576 eff (LUT layers, matches g-series). TRITON_CACHE_DIR set in wrapper.
